age.evidence: Acute colitis was induced in 8–10‐week‐old male mice by administering 3% DSS (MP Biomedicals 36,000–50,000 Da) in the drinking water for 6 days.
Male mice (8–10 weeks old male mice) were sedated using isofluorane.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Quantitative proteomics and N‐terminomics analysis of colon tissue from wild‐type male C57BL/6 and Lgmn −/− mice (n = 4/group) were completed using a modification of our previously described method (Ziegler, Dufour, Scott, & Edgington‐Mitchell, ).

sample_source.evidence: inferred: Combined, this study identifies multiple putative substrates of legumain in healthy and inflamed murine colons as well as the utility of using complementary fractionation approaches for degradomics studies.

sex.evidence: Acute colitis was induced in 8–10‐week‐old male mice by administering 3% DSS (MP Biomedicals 36,000–50,000 Da) in the drinking water for 6 days.
Male mice (8–10 weeks old male mice) were sedated using isofluorane.

Quantitative proteomics and N‐terminomics analysis of colon tissue from wild‐type male C57BL/6 and Lgmn −/− mice (n = 4/group) were completed using a modification of our previously described method (Ziegler, Dufour, Scott, & Edgington‐Mitchell, ).

strain.evidence: Wild‐type C57Bl/6 J mice were purchased from the Monash University in‐house colony or purchased from JAX (#000664).
Legumain‐deficient mice (Matthews et al., ) were kindly provided by Thomas Reinheckel and bred in the New York University animal facility.
